integrity: Analytic proof plus 512 stand-alone rational and finite-state checks; no external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the positive-noise asynchronous fair binary model on equal-petal clique windmills; joint asymptotics require n/m converging to a positive finite value. Correlation formulas do not give the full invariant law or establish uniqueness of historical priority. The 2018 stochastic-approximation paper was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Exact stationary correlation hierarchy and two noise scales on clique windmills
